content.stem: 以下哪一项最能描述扩散融资的主要威胁之一？

options.A: 敌对政府利用复杂攻击手段威胁关键基础设施和行业,包括金融、医疗保健和能源领域
options.B: 利用金融系统转移资金以获取大规模杀伤性武器或其部件的个人和实体网络
options.C: 跨国犯罪组织将其活动范围扩大到更多种类的非法活动,包括人口贩运和腐败.
options.D: 通过非法暴力或武力行为全部或部分为其意识形态目标筹集资金的个人和实体网络

content.stem_en: Which of the following best describes one of the principal threats of proliferation financing?

options_en.A: Adversary governments using sophisticated attacks to threaten critical infrastructure and sectors, including finance, health care, and energy
options_en.B: Networks of individuals and entities exploiting financial systems to move funds that will be used to acquire weapons of mass destruction or their components
options_en.C: Transnational criminal organizations expanding their engagement into more varied types of illicit activities, including human trafficking and corruption
options_en.D: Networks of individuals and entities raising funds, in whole or in part, for their ideological goals through unlawful violence or force
